title: Show prices in the reader's currency
goal: Let readers see prices in US dollars, euros or Indian rupees with `?currency=USD`, `?currency=EUR` or `?currency=INR`. Change `formatPrice(cents)` in `src/products.js` to `formatPrice(cents, currency = "USD")`, with fixed rates: 1 USD = 0.92 EUR = 83 INR. The amount is `Math.round(cents * rate) / 100` in the new currency: euros keep two decimals (`€18.39`), rupees show whole rupees with a comma for thousands (1999 cents → `₹1,659`), dollars stay `$19.99`, and an unknown code falls back to USD. Pass the currency from `renderPage` through `renderItem` to `formatPrice`, and add relative links that switch the currency (for example `href="?currency=EUR"`).

checks.description: formatPrice(cents, currency) converts and formats USD, EUR and INR; ?currency= changes every price on the page; the page links to each currency.

collisions.why: Changes formatPrice(cents) to formatPrice(cents, currency) and edits renderPage, where search filters the list.
Edits the price line of renderItem, where staff-picks adds its badge, and changes the formatPrice call on it.

title: Add a dark mode
goal: Add a dark mode that readers can switch on and off. Put a `<button class="theme-toggle">` with `aria-pressed` at the end of the nav in the page header (`src/render.js`), with a tiny inline script that sets `data-theme` on `<html>`, updates `aria-pressed` and remembers the choice in `localStorage`. In `src/styles.js`, keep colours in CSS custom properties and override `--bg`, `--ink` and the other tokens under `[data-theme="dark"]`. Follow `prefers-color-scheme: dark` until the reader makes a choice.

checks.description: The header has a theme toggle with aria-pressed and an inline script; the CSS sets dark tokens under [data-theme="dark"] and follows prefers-color-scheme.

collisions.why: Both change renderHeader in src/render.js and the HEADER styles in src/styles.js.

title: Search books by title or author
goal: Let readers search the books by title or author. Add `export function findProducts(query)` to `src/products.js`: it returns the books whose title or author contains the trimmed query, in any case, and every book for an empty or missing query. Add a search form to the page header (`role="search"`, a field `name="q"`, a relative `action="./"`) and filter the list with `?q=`. Keep the prices on the results, keep the query in the search box, and show `No books match your search.` when nothing matches.

checks.description: findProducts(query) matches title or author in any case; the header has a search form; ?q= filters the list, keeps prices and the query, and handles no match.

collisions.why: Renders the filtered list with renderItem and formatPrice, whose signature currency changes; both edit renderPage.
Both put new controls into the header: renderHeader and the HEADER styles.

title: Mark staff picks
goal: Mark three books as staff picks: The Tidewater Almanac (id 1), Fog over Marram Point (id 6) and A Small Book of Tides (id 8). Set `staffPick: true` on them in `PRODUCTS` (`src/products.js`). In `renderItem` (`src/render.js`), show `Staff pick` next to the price, inside the price line of each staff pick. Other books show no badge.

checks.description: Books 1, 6 and 8 are staff picks and show a Staff pick badge in the price line; other books show none.

collisions.why: Edits the price line of renderItem, which calls formatPrice; currency changes that call and the signature.

title: Add a JSON endpoint for one book
goal: Add `GET /api/products/:id` to `src/index.js`, so that other apps can fetch one book. Return the book as JSON with status 200, or `{ "error": "…" }` as JSON with status 404 when no book has that id. Keep `/api/products` unchanged.

checks.description: GET /api/products/:id returns one book as JSON, or a 404 JSON error for an unknown id.
